description: Angular component for configuring circle settings in a widget map, including form controls, validation, and dynamic validator updates.

classes.name: CircleSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing circle settings in a widget, implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator interfaces.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group, sets up value change subscriptions, and updates validators.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Method for registering touch callback (empty implementation).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form with provided CircleSettings value and updates validators.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically enables/disables form controls based on current form state.
